title: Desktop and phone: a dead 'Collapse the step' chevron shows in every full callout
detail: The new fold button (.tour-fold) should show only on an unfolded phone step that covers the work area (.tour-card.over). The tour CSS hides it with `.tour-grow, .tour-fold { display: none }`. The button also has the app class `icon-btn`, and the app's `.icon-btn, .collapse-btn { display: inline-grid }` has the same specificity and comes later, so it wins. Result: a chevron-down button sits next to X in every callout head. It is 36 px on desktop and 44 px on a phone. Pressing it does nothing: ui.expanded is already false, and the card rect stays the same. So desktop got worse: there is a new, unexplained, dead control in every step. On a phone it shows on all 18 steps that are not collapsed (for example basics/chain and basics/examples). The grow button has no icon-btn class, so it is hidden correctly. tour_cmd, the audit and tour_phone_cmd all passed because they only check that buttons are 36/44 px and fit inside the card.
evidence: 1440x900, mouse, EN, basics/1: computed display 'grid', rect 947,264 to 983,300 (36x36). Matching rules: '.tour-grow, .tour-fold {display:none}' and '.icon-btn, .collapse-btn {display:inline-grid}'. Clicked: the card rect is unchanged (712,259 320x209.5) and focus moves to the fold button. 390x844 RU, basics/9: 44x44, display grid, card class 'tour-card sheet' (no 'over'). Shots: notes/tour/shots/review-phone/desk_fold_crop.png and chain_after_tap.png (the chevron next to X). Script: shots/review-phone/cmd/fold2.js, chev.js.
fix: Raise the hiding rule's specificity: `.tour-card .tour-fold { display: none }` and `.tour-card.over .tour-fold { display: inline-grid }`. The same safety applies to .tour-grow with `.tour-card .tour-grow` and `.tour-card.mini .tour-grow`. Alternatively, drop the `icon-btn` class from the fold button. Add a check to tour_cmd (1440) and tour_phone_cmd: the fold button has offsetParent === null unless the card has .over.

title: Try it 'Tap the card f1, then the lens in the sheet': the dimming takes the tap on the lens
detail: basics/chain lights only the chain bar. Tapping f1 opens the Inspector sheet, and the chain bar rides up to 407-471. The task's second target, the lens ('Show this step alone' in the sheet header), is under the fixed shade, which takes the tap with preventDefault and nudges. By touch the Try it cannot be completed. This is exactly the brief's 'never let the dimming or the callout swallow touches meant for the work area (the area named in the task)'. The build added `try.work` for this, but no step uses it, so the work area of every Try it is still just its lit area. This is pre-existing (v15 behaves the same) but it is in scope for v15.1. Every other Try it worked by touch with the tour open: Choose Phase, Choose Landscape (portrait), Open ⋯ then Search, Hold X then Add zero here, Choose Stretch (also from the unfolded bar, which folds back), Choose Disc. The integral one ('Hold the circle') was not reached: no circle was found under the plane's centre.
evidence: 390x844 EN light, basics/7. After touching the f1 card (296,723): Tour.lit().layers = 1 (DIV.ph-sheet open), holes = [0,407,390,471], and work is the same. elementFromPoint(246,527) on the lens button is 'TOUR:root:tour-shade'. After a touch there, the try box is still 'tour-try' (not done). v15-candidate gives the same result. Shot: shots/review-phone/chain_after_tap.png (sheet dimmed, lens under the shade). Script: cmd/chain3.js, chain3v15.js, tries.js.
fix: Give basics/chain `try: { ..., work: ['inspector lens anchor'] }` (or 'inspector'), so the lens is lit and in the work area once the sheet opens. More generally, when a Try it's step is open and a layer opens that the task needs (a sheet opened by the task), treat that layer as work: cut it from the shade, let touches through, and keep the callout off it. Add a test that performs every Try it by touch on a phone with the tour open and asserts that the task completes (try box gets 'done'). Advancing with Tour.next() does not test this.

title: Chain bar steps: one swipe from the lit + scrolls the target away, and then the chain bar cannot be scrolled back
detail: The chain bar (#pipeline) has a scroll-fade mask, so it is not hosted. Touches reach it only through the lit hole, and the rest of the bar is under the fixed shade. At 360x780 during basics/add (Add a function), a swipe that starts on the lit + button scrolls the bar (scrollLeft 302 to 0), and the + leaves the bar's visible box. Tour.lit().holes becomes [], so the whole bar is dimmed. Every later touch on the bar hits the shade, and the user cannot scroll it back. The step is dead until Next or Back. v15 is the same (there, the callout covered that point at 360). The brief asked that the work area of a step include the panel the user scrolls. That was done for hosted sheets (their window lets touches through) but not for the chain bar. The shade's hole over the chain bar is also still script-followed during a fling, so it lags. Only the rings fade, as PHONE.md admits. The chain bar is exactly the kind of 'selection' the user saw jiggle.
evidence: 360x780 EN, basics/8. At start: anchor 229.9,627 to 273.9,679, pipeline 74,627 to 282,690, scrollLeft 302. synthesizeScrollGesture from the + (+200 px x): scrollLeft 0, anchor at l=531.9 (outside the bar), holes []. HIT(104,653) = TOUR:root:tour-shade. A second swipe of -250 px from there leaves scrollLeft at 0. Script: cmd/add2.js and add2v15.js. Frames: rvp scratch add_f0..f8 show the whole bar dimmed with no hole.
fix: Treat the chain bar's visible box like a hosted panel's window: open it in the fixed shade, so touches scroll it but presses on its other controls are stopped. A transparent touch catcher inside #pipeline can do that. Better still, host it: while a step lights the chain bar, replace its mask with an overlay gradient, or set mask-image: none on the bar. Then the ring, the shade and the scroll are native, and no shade edge lags. Also, if a lit part scrolls fully out of its panel, scroll it back (scrollIntoView with inline 'nearest') once the fling ends, or show a hint.

title: Landscape phone: the collapsed bar covers the work area (13 of 38 step views) and the whole header
detail: The phone was rotated to 844x390 (safe area 47 px left and right, 21 px bottom). The bar is 52 px tall, full width, at y=2. The header is about 47 px, so the bar covers the top 6 px of the lit plane on most plane steps. placeMini() takes the edge with the least overlap, but it never refuses an edge that still covers the work area; only an open layer makes it return null. In the walk through the whole tour (RU, dark), edit/cards had the bar 45 px deep over its lit view switch. That is the very control its Try it ('Choose Landscape') asks the user to tap. When edit/cards was started directly, or reached from views/5, it got a full card clear of the switch, so the bad placement depends on state. The bar also covers the app's whole header row in landscape.
evidence: 844x390 RU dark, Next through the whole tour (cmd/enum2.js): bar 55,2 to 789,54 overlaps the work area in basics/preimages, shapes, views/phase, land, sphere, patterns, edit/cards (18690 px², 45 px deep), edit/zp, numbers, deform/transport, analysis/targets, cauchy, branches/sheets (each about 6 px deep, 1122 to 4404 px²). EN basics/1 after rotating mid-step: 2202 px² over the plane 47,48 to 422,338. Shot: shots/review-phone/land.png (top: X, the bar over the header and the plane's top edge). Portrait 390 and 360: 0 overlaps.
fix: In placeMini, keep only edges with w === 0. Otherwise try a shorter bar (the header height, 44 px, with no outer padding) or a bar only as wide as the free part of the edge (beside the lit area, for example the right half of the header in landscape), and dock as the last resort. Add landscape (844x390 and 780x360, notch left and right) to tour_phone_cmd's work check.

title: The collapsed bar hides the Try it task and never shows that it was done
detail: At 390 and 360, 21 of 39 phone steps open as the bar, which shows only the title, the count and Next. 9 of them are Try it steps: preimages, draw, patterns, zp, zpHere, numbers, transport, integral and cut. The bar does not say there is a task or what it is. To read it, the user must tap the title. The whole step then covers the work area again, and the first touch in the work area folds it back. So the user has to read, memorise the task, and then act. When the task is done, the try box gets 'done', but it is hidden in the bar: the bar text is identical before and after ('Patterns 6 of 6 Next'). Each new step starts collapsed again, so a user who wants to read every explanation taps 21 extra times. The bar meets the letter of the brief, but on most steps the tour's teaching text and its tasks are now hidden by default.
evidence: 390x844 EN, views/patterns: the bar text before is 'Patterns 6 of 6 Next'. Then: unfold, touch Stretch at 246,709 (the touch reaches the app, the card folds, the try box becomes 'tour-try done'), and the bar text after is the same 'Patterns 6 of 6 Next'. Collapsed Try it steps at 360 RU (cmd/enum2.js): basics/preimages, basics/draw, views/patterns, edit/zp, edit/zpHere, edit/numbers, deform/transport, analysis/integral, branches/cut. Shots: shots/review-phone/bars.png, fold_expanded.png.
fix: On a Try it step, the bar should show the task's touch text (the short line, for example 'Choose Stretch.' / 'Выберите «Растяжение».') with the try's ring icon, instead of the title or as a second 18 px line. It should turn to the check when done, and Next gets the primary pulse it has on full cards. Optionally, show the full step once (unfolded, not over the work area if a smaller card fits, else for a short moment) when a step starts, then fold it on the first touch in the work area.

title: Race in stop(): the deferred dropHost puts a hosted panel back to position: static under a new tour run, and the jiggle returns
detail: stop() removes the old run's hosts 140 ms later. If a new run starts on a hosted step in the same panel within those 140 ms, the new run's hostSvg first makes the panel position: relative. Then the old dropHost sees position 'relative' and pos0 '', and resets it to static, while the new run's svg.tour-host is still inside. The host SVG is then positioned against the sheet, not the scrolling content. The ring stays put while the content scrolls, and moves only at the layout 140 ms after the scroll calms. That is worse than v15. Tour.start() while a tour runs does this; the help menu's Resume/chapter items can do it from a running tour (the help step lights the help button).
evidence: 390x844. Tour.start basics/5, then Tour.start basics/6 while active. The .ph-sb is position static with an inline position of ''. After scrollTop += 80, the ring moved 0 px in the next frame and -80 px only after 400 ms. The same steps reached with Tour.next() are fine (relative, ring moves -80 in the same frame). Script: cmd/stat.js, stat2.js.
fix: Mark the panel with a counter or owner (for example H.dataset.tourHost = run id), and in dropHost restore the position only if this run still owns it and no other svg.tour-host is in H. Alternatively, drop hosts synchronously in stop() and fade only the old SVG. Add a test: restart on a hosted step within 50 ms and check that the ring moves in the same frame as a programmatic scroll.

title: Landscape with nothing lit: the step collapses to the bar although no area needs to stay clear
detail: Rotating mid-step closes the sheet (an app behaviour; the anchor is gone), so the step has no lit area and an empty work area. place() takes the landscape path `if (opt.mini) return MINI` after no beside-candidate fits, so the step shows as the bar over the header. v15 showed the full centred card with the text, which here covers nothing the user works in.
evidence: 390x844 to 844x390 rotation during views/5, edit/4 and analysis/3: Tour.lit().work = [], mini true, bar at 55,2 to 789,54. v15: centred card 163,... with the full text. Shot: shots/review-phone/land.png (rows 2 and 3: new and v15).
fix: Return MINI only when the work area is not empty (holes.length > 0). With nothing lit, place the card centred as before.

title: Bar details: chapter hop hidden, no Back, a truncated RU title, the step not announced, a cramped focus ring
detail: (a) On a chapter's last step, Next in the bar reads 'Next' / 'Далее'. The full card says 'Next: Deformation' / 'Далее: Деформация', so the user is not told they are leaving the chapter. The aria-label keeps the full text. (b) Back is hidden in the bar, so going back needs an unfold. (c) 360 RU deform/transport: the title 'Воспроизведение и перемотка' is cut with an ellipsis. (d) The grow button has aria-label 'Show the whole step' / 'Показать шаг целиком', which replaces its visible text, so a screen reader never hears which step the bar is on. (e) Next's focus ring (2 px with a 2 px offset) touches the bar's own border and the count. All buttons are 44 px tall and inside the bar, in both languages, at 360 and 390.
evidence: Bar buttons, from cmd/bar.js: grow 214 to 248 x 44, Next 60 to 71 x 44, no clipping. Shot: shots/review-phone/bars.png (360 RU dark: X / Общие числа / Все листы; 390 EN light: X). cmd/enum2.js trunc: 'deform/transport Воспроизведение и перемотка'.
fix: (a) In the bar, show a chapter arrow or 'Далее →' with the next chapter in the title tooltip, or keep the short chapter name when it fits. (c) Allow 2 lines for the title at 360, or shorten the count to '5/6'. (d) Use aria-label = title + ', ' + $t('Show the whole step'), or put aria-describedby on a hidden hint. (e) Use outline-offset: -2px inside the bar (or 1px), and add 2 px more gap before Next.

title: tour_phone_cmd.js gives false jiggle readings near a panel edge, and covers only 3 scroll cases
detail: I ran the new test's scroll section on 5 more steps at 360x780, RU, dark. 4 read 0/0, but branches/inverse (hosted) read 13.67 px max and 9.67 px p95 on screen. The composited frames show the ring and the target moving together, both clipped at the same line as the ⋯ button scrolls under the sheet's top. The strip reader takes the target's edge where the panel clips it. So the test can fail a correct build, and its 'before' numbers may be inflated in the same way. It also never measures the shade's hole edge, where the chain bar still lags, or a scroll started outside the lit hole.
evidence: 360x780 RU dark (copy of tour_phone_cmd.js with CASES = deform/toggle, deform/order, analysis/domain, branches/inverse, basics/formula). Results: order 0/0, domain 0/0, formula 0/0, inverse 13.67/9.67, toggle 'nothing scrolls'. Raw inverse frames: [0, 0.67, 2.67, 4.67, 5.67 ... 11.67, 13.67, 9.67 ...]. Frames shots/review-phone/inv_strip.png: green and magenta stay together. Script: cmd/inv2.js.
fix: Ignore readings where the green edge is within 6 px of the panel's visible edge, or of any element painted over it. Measure both the ring and the shade hole: the hole edge is where luminance steps. Loop the scroll check over every hosted step plus the chain bar steps, and start one gesture outside the lit hole.

title: A narrow desktop window (mouse) now gets the collapsed bar
detail: Below about 640 px, the app uses the phone layout (:root.ph) also with a mouse. phoneL() is true there, so at 600x900 with a mouse and no touch, X, Preimages, Patterns and Shared numbers open as the bar. v15 showed the full card, at 12,716 to 588,888 for X. Whether that is better is debatable, since it keeps the plane clear. But it is a change for desktop users in a split window, who now lose the text by default (see phone-5).
evidence: 600x900, mobile false, touch off: basics/1 and basics/3 mini at 8,846 to 592,898; views/5 and edit/4 mini at 8,2 to 592,54. v15 basics/1: card 12,716 to 588,888. Script: cmd/misc.js, misc15.js.
fix: If the bar stays, fix phone-5 first, so the bar carries the task. Alternatively, collapse only with (pointer: coarse) and keep v15's least-overlap card for fine pointers.
